info.description: GT Biopharma, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of the immuno-oncology therapeutic products based proprietary TriKE NK cell engager platform. The TriKE platform is designed to harness and enhance the cancer killing abilities of a patient's immune system natural killer cells (NK cells). Its product, GTB-3550, is initially developed for the treatment of AML and MDS, and other CD33+ hematologic cancers. GT Biopharma has a worldwide license agreement with the University of Minnesota to further develop and commercialize therapies using TriKE technology. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: GT Biopharma, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，專注於基於專有 TriKE NK 細胞接合器平台的免疫腫瘤治療產品的開發和商業化。 TriKE 平台旨在利用和增強患者免疫系統自然殺手細胞（NK 細胞）的殺傷能力。其產品GTB-3550最初是為治療AML和MDS以及其他CD33+血液癌症而開發的。 GT Biopharma 與明尼蘇達大學簽訂了全球授權協議，以進一步開發和商業化使用 TriKE 技術的療法。該公司成立於 1965 年，總部位於加州舊金山。

The Enterprise Solutions segment offers method of sourcing, evaluating, purchasing and tracking of IT products and services. The Public Sector segment offers outbound telemarketing, including some on-site sales solicitation by business development managers, and Internet sales through Internet Business Accounts. info.description: Best Buy Co., Inc. engages in the provision of consumer technology products and services. It operates through two business segments: Domestic and International. The Domestic segment includes operations in all states and territories of the U.S., operating under various brand names, including Best Buy, Best Buy Mobile, Geek Squad, Magnolia Audio Video, and Pacific Sales. The International segment consists of operations in Canada. It also markets its products under the brand names: Best Buy, bestbuy.com, Best Buy Express, Lively, Geek Squad, Magnolia and Pacific Kitchen and Home. The company was founded by Richard M. Schulze in 1966 and is headquartered in Richfield, MN.
info.description_zh: Best Buy Co., Inc. 從事提供消費性科技產品和服務。它透過兩個業務部門運作：國內和國際。國內部門包括在美國所有州和地區的業務，以各種品牌運營，包括 Best Buy、Best Buy Mobile、Geek Squad、Magnolia Audio Video 和 Pacific Sales。國際部門包括加拿大的業務。它還以以下品牌銷售其產品：Best Buy、bestbuy.com、Best Buy Express、Lively、Geek Squad、Magnolia 和 Pacific Kitchen and Home。該公司由 Richard M. Schulze 於 1966 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州里奇菲爾德。

info.description: Elevance Health, Inc. operates as a health company, which engages in improving lives and communities, and making healthcare simpler. It operates through the following segments: Health Benefits, CarelonRx, Carelon Services, and Corporate and Other. The Health Benefits segment offers a comprehensive suite of health plans and services to different customers. The CarelonRx segment markets and offers pharmacy services to affiliated health plan customers, as well as to external customers. The Carelon Services segment integrates physical, behavioral, pharmacy, and social services with the aim of delivering whole health affordably by offering a broad array of healthcare related services. The Corporate & Other segment includes businesses that do not individually meet the quantitative threshold for an operating segment. The company was founded in 1944 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.

info.description: Wells Fargo & Co. is a diversified and community-based financial services company, which engages in the provision of banking, insurance, investments, mortgage, and consumer and commercial finance products and services. It operates through the following segments: Consumer Banking and Lending, Commercial Banking, Corporate and Investment Banking, and Wealth and Investment Management. The Consumer Banking and Lending segment offers consumer and small business banking, home lending, credit cards, auto, and personal lending. The Commercial Banking segment provides banking and credit products across industry sectors and municipalities, secured lending and lease products, and treasury management. The Corporate and Investment Banking segment is composed of corporate banking, investment banking, treasury management, commercial real estate lending and servicing, and equity and fixed income solutions, as well as sales, trading, and research capabilities. The Wealth and Investment Management segment refers to personalized wealth management, brokerage, financial planning, lending, private banking, trust, and fiduciary products and services. The company was founded by Henry Wells and William G. Fargo on March 18, 1852 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: 富國銀行是一家多元化、以社區為基礎的金融服務公司，從事提供銀行、保險、投資、抵押貸款以及消費者和商業金融產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：消費者銀行和貸款部門、商業銀行部門、企業和投資銀行部門以及財富和投資管理部門。消費者銀行和貸款部門提供消費者和小型企業銀行業務、房屋貸款、信用卡、汽車和個人貸款。商業銀行部門提供跨行業和市政當局的銀行和信貸產品、擔保貸款和租賃產品以及資金管理。企業和投資銀行部門由企業銀行、投資銀行、資金管理、商業房地產貸款和服務、股票和固定收益解決方案以及銷售、交易和研究能力組成。財富與投資管理部門指個人化財富管理、經紀、財務規劃、貸款、私人銀行、信託和信託產品和服務。該公司由 Henry Wells 和 William G. Fargo 於 1852 年 3 月 18 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州舊金山。

info.description: REX Crypto Equity Premium Income ETF seeks capital appreciation and current income. The fund, under normal market conditions, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of companies comprising the BITA Crypto Assets & Digital Payments Index. The index is a rules-based composite index that tracks the market performance of 25 companies, listed on regulated exchanges based in the U.S., that are actively engaged in crypto-related activities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: REX 加密股票溢價收入 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於包含 BITA 加密資產和數位支付指數的公司的股本證券。該指數是一個基於規則的綜合指數，追蹤 25 家在美國受監管交易所上市、積極從事加密貨幣相關活動的公司的市場表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TradersAI Large Cap Equity & Cash ETF seeks maximum total return. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (ETF) that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in securities and financial instruments linked to the S&P 500 Index. The fund manager takes both long and short positions by investing in e-mini futures contracts. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in large cap equities or investments with similar characteristics, or cash and cash equivalents.
info.description_zh: TradersAI Large Cap Equity & Cash ETF 尋求最大的總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金 (ETF)，旨在透過投資與標準普爾 500 指數掛鉤的證券和金融工具來實現其投資目標。基金經理人透過投資電子迷你期貨合約來持有多頭和空頭部位。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於大盤股或具有類似特徵的投資，或現金及現金等價物。

info.description: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. is a global edge-to-cloud company, which engages in the provision of information technology, technology and enterprise products, solutions, and services. It operates through the following segments: Server, Hybrid Cloud, Intelligent Edge, Financial Services, and Corporate Investments and Other. The Server segment consists of general-purpose servers for multi-workload computing and workload-optimized servers to deliver the performance and value for demanding applications, and integrated systems comprised of software and hardware designed to address high-performance computing and supercomputing, artificial intelligence, data analytics, and transaction processing workloads for government and commercial customers globally. The Hybrid Cloud segment is involved in a variety of cloud-native and hybrid solutions across storage, private cloud, and the infrastructure software-as-a-service space. The Intelligent Edge segment offers wired and wireless local area networks, campus, branch, and data center switching, software-defined wide-area-networks, private and public cellular network software, network security, and associated services that enable secure connectivity for businesses of any size. The Financial Services segment provides investment solutions, such as leasing, financing, IT consumption, utility programs, and asset management services for customers that facilitate technology deployment models and the acquisition of complete IT solutions, including hardware, software, and services from Hewlett Packard Enterprise and others. The Corporate Investments and Other segment includes the Advisory and Professional Services business, which primarily offers consultative-led services, HPE and partner technology expertise and advice, implementation services, as well as complex solution engagement capabilities, the Communications and Media Solutions business, which primarily offers software and related services to the telecommunications industry, and Hewlett Packard Labs, which is responsible for research and development. The company was founded by William R. Hewlett and David Packard on July 2, 1939 and is headquartered in Spring, TX.
info.description_zh: 惠普企業有限公司是一家全球邊緣到雲端公司，從事提供資訊科技、技術和企業產品、解決方案和服務。它透過以下部門運作：伺服器部門、混合雲部門、智慧邊緣部門、金融服務部門以及企業投資及其他部門。伺服器部門包括用於多工作負載運算的通用伺服器和工作負載優化伺服器，為要求苛刻的應用程式提供效能和價值，以及由軟體和硬體組成的整合系統，旨在為全球政府和商業客戶解決高效能運算和超級運算、人工智慧、數據分析和事務處理工作負載。混合雲部門涉及跨儲存、私有雲和基礎設施軟體即服務領域的各種雲端原生和混合解決方案。智慧邊緣部門提供有線和無線區域網路、園區、分公司和資料中心交換、軟體定義的廣域網路、專用和公共蜂窩網路軟體、網路安全以及相關服務，為任何規模的企業提供安全連線。金融服務部門為客戶提供投資解決方案，例如租賃、融資、IT消費、公用事業計劃和資產管理服務，以促進技術部署模型和從慧與等公司購買完整的IT解決方案，包括硬體、軟體和服務。企業投資和其他部門包括諮詢和專業服務業務（主要提供諮詢主導的服務、慧與和合作夥伴技術專業知識和建議、實施服務以及複雜的解決方案參與能力）、通訊和媒體解決方案業務（主要向電信行業提供軟體和相關服務）以及惠普實驗室（負責研發）。該公司由 William R. Hewlett 和 David Packard 於 1939 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州斯普林。

info.description: Humana Inc. engages in the provision of health insurance services. It operates through the Insurance and CenterWell segments. The Insurance segment consists of Medicare benefits, marketed to individuals or directly via group Medicare accounts, as well as contract with CMS to administer the Limited Income Newly Eligible Transition, or LI-NET, prescription drug plan program and contracts with various states to provide Medicaid, dual eligible demonstration, and Long-Term Support Services benefits, which refer to as state-based contracts. The CenterWell segment represents payor-agnostic healthcare services offerings, including pharmacy dispensing services, provider services, and home services. The company was founded by David A. Jones, Sr., and Wendell Cherry on August 18, 1961 and is headquartered in Louisville, KY.

info.description: SPDR Galaxy Transformative Tech Accelerators ETF seeks to provide long term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing in equity securities of foreign and domestic Transformative Tech Accelerators. Transformative Tech Accelerators are companies that provide products or services contributing to the disruptive potential of novel technologies (e.g., blockchain and artificial intelligence ("AI")). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR Galaxy Transformative Tech Accelerators ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。副顧問尋求透過投資國內外轉型技術加速器的股本證券來實現基金的投資目標。變革性技術加速器是提供有助於新技術（例如區塊鏈和人工智慧（“AI”））顛覆性潛力的產品或服務的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of waste management solutions and services. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Concrete Pumping, U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services, and the U.K. Operations. The U.S. Concrete Pumping segment includes services under the Brundage-Bone and Capital Pumping trade names. The U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services segment is involved in the pans and containers rented to customers and the disposal services under the Eco-Pan trade name. The U.K. Operations segment relates to the concrete pumping services and leasing of concrete pumping equipment to customers under the Camfaud Concrete Pumps and Premier Concrete Pumping trade names. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Thornton, CO.
info.description_zh: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. 從事提供廢棄物管理解決方案和服務。它透過以下部門運作：美國混凝土泵送部門、美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門和英國營運部門。美國混凝土泵送部門包括以 Brundage-Bone 和 Capital Pumping 商標名稱提供的服務。美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門提供向客戶出租的盤子和容器以及以 Eco-Pan 商標名稱提供的處置服務。英國營運部門涉及混凝土泵送服務以及以 Camfaud Concrete Pumps 和 Premier Concrete Pumping 商標名向客戶租賃混凝土泵送設備。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於科羅拉多州桑頓。

info.description_zh: iShares Asia 50 ETF 旨在追蹤由 50 隻最大的亞洲股票組成的 S&P Asia 50TM 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Vistra Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of electricity and power generation. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Texas, East, West, and Asset Closure. The Retail segment includes sale of electricity and natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The Texas and East segments are involved in electricity generation, wholesale energy sales and purchases, commodity risk management activities, fuel production and fuel logistics management. The West segment represents the company's electricity generation operations in CAISO. The Asset Closure segment refers to the decommissioning and reclamation of retired plants and mines. The company was founded in 1882 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 獨立電力生產商
info.description_zh: Vistra Corp.是一家控股公司，從事提供電力和發電業務。該公司透過以下部門營運：零售部門、德州部門、東部部門、西部部門和資產關閉部門。零售部門包括向住宅、商業和工業客戶銷售電力和天然氣。德州和東部部門從事發電、批發能源銷售和採購、商品風險管理活動、燃料生產和燃料物流管理。西部部門代表該公司在 CAISO 的發電業務。資產關閉部分是指退役工廠和礦山的退役和復墾。該公司成立於 1882 年，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in GOOGL that is equal, on a daily basis, to -100% of the value of the fund's net assets. info.description_zh: Direxion Daily GOOGL Bear 1X Shares 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果與 Alphabet Inc. 每日業績相反（或相反）的 100%。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項掉期協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 GOOGL 的投資所賺取的回報，該回報每天等於該基金淨資產價值的 -100%。它是非多元化的。

The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the underlying security while managing potential downside through a specific volatility-linked framework.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤 CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌選擇權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎證券的敞口，同時透過特定的波動性相關框架管理潛在的下行風險。

info.description: Power Solutions International, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and trade of power systems and electrical power generation equipment. The firm provides integrated turnkey solutions to global original equipment manufacturers and end-user customers within the energy, industrial, and transportation end markets. info.description: Defiance AI & Power Infrastructure ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the MarketVector US Listed AI and Power Infrastructure Index. info.description: Defiance Retail Kings ETF is an actively managed fund that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in U.S.-listed companies demonstrating high retail investor sentiment and digital engagement. info.description_zh: Defiance Retail Kings ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過投資表現出高散戶投資者情緒和數位參與度的美國上市公司來實現長期資本增值。該基金利用專有模型來識別「零售之王」——線上投資者社群中最受歡迎或趨勢領先的公司——同時進一步審查它們的基本彈性和競爭護城河。

info.description: Direxion Daily INTC Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of INTC. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of INTC and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to INTC, consistent with the fund's investment objective. info.description_zh: Direxion Daily INTC Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 INTC 每日業績的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 INTC 的證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 INTC 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Bitdeer Technologies Group engages in the cryptocurrency mining industry. It generates income through its proprietary mining datacenters. info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long INTC Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Intel Corp. info.description: La Rosa Holdings Corp. operates as a holding company, which provides real estate brokerage services. It sells technology-based products and services primarily to sales agents and the sales agents associated with its franchisees. info.description: Direxion Daily QCOM Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of QCOM. info.description: Fuel Tech, Inc. engages in the development, commercialization and application of proprietary technologies for air pollution control, process optimization, water treatment, and advanced engineering services. It operates through the following segments: Air Pollution Control, Fuel Chem Technologies, and Other. The Air Pollution Control Technology segment includes technologies to reduce nitrogen oxides emissions in flue gas from boilers, incinerators, furnaces, and other stationary combustion sources. The Fuel Chem Technology segment uses chemical processes in combination with computational fluid dynamics, and chemical kinetics modeling boiler modeling, for the control of slagging, fouling, corrosion, opacity, and other sulfur trioxide-related issues in furnaces, and boilers. The Other segment includes those profit and loss items not allocated to either reportable segment. The company was founded by Burr T. Walter in 1987 and is headquartered in Warrenville, IL.
info.description_zh: Fuel Tech, Inc. 從事空氣污染控制、製程優化、水處理和先進工程服務專有技術的開發、商業化和應用。它透過以下部門運作：空氣污染控制部門、燃料化學技術部門和其他部門。空氣污染控制技術部門包括減少鍋爐、焚化爐、熔爐和其他固定燃燒源煙氣中氮氧化物排放的技術。燃料化學技術部門將化學過程與計算流體動力學和化學動力學建模鍋爐建模相結合，用於控制熔爐和鍋爐中的結渣、污垢、腐蝕、不透明和其他與三氧化硫相關的問題。其他分部包括未分配至任一報告分部的損益項目。該公司由 Burr T. Walter 於 1987 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州沃倫維爾。

info.description: QUALCOMM, Inc. engages in developing and commercializing foundational technologies and products used in mobile devices and other wireless products. It operates through the following segments: Qualcomm CDMA Technologies (QCT), Qualcomm Technology Licensing (QTL), and Qualcomm Strategic Initiatives (QSI). The QCT segment develops and supplies integrated circuits and system software based on technologies for use in voice and data communications, networking, application processing, multimedia, and global positioning system products. The QTL segment grants licenses and provides rights to use portions of the firm's intellectual property portfolio. The QSI segment focuses on opening new or expanding opportunities for its technologies and supporting the design and introduction of new products and services for voice and data communications. The company was founded by Franklin P. Antonio, Adelia A. Coffman, Andrew Cohen, Klein Gilhousen, Irwin Mark Jacobs, Andrew J. Viterbi, and Harvey P. White in July 1985 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: QUALCOMM, Inc. 致力於行動裝置和其他無線產品中使用的基礎技術和產品的開發和商業化。該公司透過以下部門營運：高通 CDMA 技術部門 (QCT)、高通技術授權部門 (QTL) 和高通策略計畫部門 (QSI)。 QCT 部門開發並提供基於語音和數據通訊、網路、應用處理、多媒體和全球定位系統產品技術的積體電路和系統軟體。 QTL 部門授予許可並提供使用公司部分智慧財產權組合的權利。 QSI 部門專注於為其技術開闢新的或擴大的機會，並支援語音和數據通訊新產品和服務的設計和推出。該公司由 Franklin P. Antonio、Adelia A. Coffman、Andrew Cohen、Klein Gilhousen、Irwin Mark Jacobs、Andrew J. Viterbi 和 Harvey P. White 於 1985 年 7 月創立，總部位於加州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Corsair Gaming, Inc. designs and supplies hardware components for personal computers. It operates through the Gamer and Creator Peripherals, and Gaming Components and Systems segments. The Gamer and Creator Peripherals segment offers gaming keyboards, mice, headsets, controllers, and gaming gear including capture cards, Stream Decks, USB microphones, studio accessories, and EpocCam software, as well as coaching and training services. info.description: Frequency Electronics, Inc. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of precision time and frequency generation technology. The company was founded by Martin B. Bloch on August 25, 1961 and is headquartered in Uniondale, NY.

info.description: First Trust Alternative Absolute Return Strategy ETF seeks to provide investors with long-term total return. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve long-term total return through long and short investments in exchange-traded commodity futures contracts ("Commodity Futures") through a wholly-owned subsidiary of the fund organized under the laws of the Cayman Islands (the "Subsidiary"). It does not invest directly in Commodity Futures. The advisor gains exposure to these investments exclusively by investing in the Subsidiary. info.description_zh: First Trust Alternative絕對回報策略ETF旨在為投資者提供長期總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過該基金根據開曼群島法律組成的全資子公司（「子公司」）對交易所交易商品期貨合約（「商品期貨」）進行多頭和空頭投資，以實現長期總回報。它不會直接投資於商品期貨。顧問僅透過投資子公司來獲得這些投資的機會。該子公司由該基金的投資顧問 First Trust Advisors L.P. 提供諮詢服務。

info.description: Nicholas Bitcoin Tail ETF is an actively managed fund that implements a systematic options-based strategy designed to hedge against significant declines in the price of bitcoin and bitcoin-related investments. The fund seeks to provide investors with a "tail risk" or defensive profile relative to the cryptocurrency market by utilizing long put options to capture gains during sharp market downturns while employing call spreads to mitigate the cost of the protection.
info.description_zh: Nicholas Bitcoin Tail ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，實施基於選擇權的系統策略，旨在對沖比特幣和比特幣相關投資價格的大幅下跌。該基金旨在透過利用多頭看跌期權在市場急劇下滑期間獲取收益，同時利用看漲期權價差來降低保護成本，為投資者提供相對於加密貨幣市場的「尾部風險」或防禦性配置。

info.description: Paloma Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded by Anna Nahajski-Staples on August 19, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Paloma Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Anna Nahajski-Staples 於 2025 年 8 月 19 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: ProShares UltraShort Nasdaq Biotechnology seeks daily investment results that correspond to two times the inverse (-2x) of the daily performance of the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective. The index is a modified capitalization weighted index that includes securities of Nasdaq listed companies that are classified as either biotechnology or pharmaceutical. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares UltraShort 納斯達克生物技術尋求相當於納斯達克生物技術指數每日表現的兩倍（-2x）的每日投資結果。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與基金投資目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數是修改後的資本加權指數，包括納斯達克上市公司的證券，這些公司被分類為生物技術或製藥。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Karbon Capital Partners Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded in 2025 and is headquartered in Scranton, PA.
info.description_zh: Karbon Capital Partners Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州斯克蘭頓。

info.description: iShares MSCI Turkey ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Turkey IMI 25/50 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the large-, mid- and small-capitalization segments of equity market in Turkey. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 土耳其 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 土耳其 IMI 25/50 指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數旨在衡量土耳其股票市場大、中、小型股的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Momentum & Value ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Dorsey Wright Momentum Plus Value TM Index (the "index"). Under normal conditions, the fund will invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the equity securities that comprise the index. The index is a rules-based equity index designed to track the overall performance of the 50 most undervalued stocks comprising the NASDAQ US Large Mid Cap Index TM that exhibit high levels of "relative strength."
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Momentum & Value ETF 尋求與稱為 Dorsey Wright Momentum Plus Value TM 指數（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少90%的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的股本證券。該指數是一個基於規則的股票指數，旨在追蹤納斯達克美國大中型股指數 TM 中最被低估的 50 隻股票的整體表現，這些股票表現出高水平的「相對強度」。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ ABA Community Bank Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ OMX ABA Community Bank TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of small, mid and large capitalization companies that comprise the community banking industry.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ ABA Community Bank Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 NASDAQ OMX ABA Community Bank TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤社區銀行業中小型、中型和大型資本公司的表現。

info.description: Intel Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of computer products and technologies. It delivers computer, networking, data storage, and communications platforms. The firm operates through the following segments: Client Computing Group (CCG), Data Center and AI (DCAI), Intel Foundry Services (IFS), and All Other. The CCG segment consists of platforms designed for notebooks, 2-in-1 systems, desktops, tablets, phones, wireless and wired connectivity products, and mobile communication components. The DCAI segment delivers solutions to cloud service providers and enterprise customers, along with silicon devices for communications service providers and high-performance computing customers. The IFS segment refers to full stack solutions created from the foundry industry ecosystem. The All Other segment represents results from other non-reportable segments and corporate-related charges. The company was founded by Robert Norton Noyce and Gordon Earle Moore on July 18, 1968, and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: 英特爾公司從事電腦產品和技術的設計、製造和銷售。它提供電腦、網路、資料儲存和通訊平台。該公司透過以下部門運作：客戶端計算部門 (CCG)、資料中心和人工智慧 (DCAI)、英特爾代工服務 (IFS) 和所有其他部門。 CCG 部門包括專為筆記型電腦、二合一系統、桌上型電腦、平板電腦、手機、無線和有線連接產品以及行動通訊組件設計的平台。 DCAI部門為雲端服務供應商和企業客戶提供解決方案，並為通訊服務供應商和高效能運算客戶提供矽設備。 IFS 部分是指從代工產業生態系統創建的全端解決方案。所有其他部門代表其他非報告部門的績效和公司相關費用。該公司由羅伯特·諾頓·諾伊斯 (Robert Norton Noyce) 和戈登·厄爾·摩爾 (Gordon Earle Moore) 於 1968 年 7 月 18 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖克拉拉。

info.description: iShares Global Clean Energy ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Global Clean Energy IndexTM composed of global equities in the clean energy sector. The index is designed to track the performance of approximately 100 clean energy-related companies. The fund generally invests at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents, as well as in securities not included in the index. It is non-diversified.

info.description: BioRestorative Therapies, Inc. engages in the development of therapeutic products and medical therapies using cell and tissue protocols. Its programs provide quality of care for chronic back pain caused by disc degeneration and metabolic disorders, including obesity and diabetes. The company's initial investigational therapeutic product being called BRTX-100 focuses on treating damage by an autologous stem cell product that uses own stem cells that are harvested, cultured, and then injected directly into the affected disc to start the repair process. BioRestorative Therapies was founded on June 13, 1997 and is headquartered in Melville, NY.
info.description_zh: BioRestorative Therapies, Inc. 從事利用細胞和組織方案開發治療產品和醫學療法。其項目為椎間盤退化和代謝紊亂（包括肥胖和糖尿病）引起的慢性背痛提供優質護理。該公司最初的研究性治療產品名為 BRTX-100，專注於透過自體幹細胞產品治療損傷，該產品使用收穫、培養的自體幹細胞，然後直接注射到受影響的椎間盤中以啟動修復過程。 BioRestorative Therapies 成立於 1997 年 6 月 13 日，總部位於紐約州梅爾維爾。

info.description: Global X Hydrogen ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Global Hydrogen Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets, plus borrowings for investments purposes (if any), in the securities of the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to companies that are positioned to benefit from further advances in the field of hydrogen technology. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X Hydrogen ETF 力求提供與 Solactive Global Hydrogen Index 的價格和收益表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於指數證券以及基於指數證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該指數旨在為那些能夠從氫技術領域的進一步進步中受益的公司提供投資機會。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR Galaxy Digital Asset Ecosystem ETF seeks to provide long term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing, directly or indirectly, in (i) equity securities of foreign and domestic companies within the crypto asset and blockchain industries, (ii) exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that primarily hold bitcoin and/or ether futures contracts ("Crypto Asset Futures ETFs"), (iii) bitcoin and ether futures contracts ("crypto asset futures"), and (iv) exchange-traded products that hold bitcoin or ether as a reference asset ("Spot Crypto Asset ETPs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR Galaxy 數位資產生態系統 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。副顧問尋求透過直接或間接投資於（i）加密資產和區塊鏈產業內的外國和國內公司的股本證券，（ii）主要持有比特幣和/或以太坊期貨合約（「加密資產期貨ETF」）的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），（iii）比特幣和以太坊期貨交易（iv幣貨幣參考資產（「現貨加密資產 ETP」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fusion Fuel Green Plc engages in the research and development of solar technologies. It develops a process and technology to produce emission-free green hydrogen using concentrated photovoltaic technology. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 再生能源
info.description_zh: Fusion Fuel Green Plc 從事太陽能技術的研究和開發。它開發了一種利用聚光光伏技術生產無排放綠色氫的製程和技術。該公司成立於2018年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Hallador Energy Co. engages in business through its subsidiary, Sunrise Coal, LLC, which produces coal in the Illinois Basin for the electric power generation industry. It also owns summit terminal, a transport facility on the Ohio River. The company was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Terre Haute, IN.

info.description: Direxion Daily Nvda Bull 1.5X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 150% of the daily performance of NVDA. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of NVDA and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that provide leveraged exposure to NVDA. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily Nvda Bull 1.5X Shares 尋求每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）為 NVDA 每日表現的 150%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 NVDA 的證券以及為 NVDA 提供槓桿敞口的金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: CoreWeave, Inc. engages in the powers of the creation and delivery of the intelligence that drives innovation. It offers a solution used by organizations of all sizes that require sophisticated AI computing, from the largest of enterprises to small, well-funded start-ups. The company was founded by Michael Intrator, Brian Venturo, Peter Salanki, and Brannin McBee on September 21, 2017 and is headquartered in Livingston, NJ.
info.description_zh: CoreWeave, Inc. 致力於創造和交付推動創新的智慧。它提供的解決方案可供各種規模的需要複雜人工智慧運算的組織使用，從最大的企業到資金充足的小型新創公司。該公司由 Michael Intrator、Brian Venturo、Peter Salanki 和 Brannin McBee 於 2017 年 9 月 21 日創立，總部位於新澤西州利文斯頓。

info.description: U Power Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of vehicle sourcing. The firm broker sales of vehicles between automobile wholesalers and buyers, including small and medium sized vehicle dealers, and individual customers. It also engages in the development of its proprietary battery-swapping technology which is designed to provide a comprehensive battery power solution for electric vehicles. The company was founded by Jia Li in 2013 and is headquartered in Wuhu, China.

info.description: Scienjoy Holding Corp. provides mobile entertainment live streaming platforms in China. The firm operates its platforms on both PC and mobile apps, through which users can enjoy immersive and interactive entertainment live streaming. Its different platforms include broadcaster policy, events, promotion and games. The firm also provides technological infrastructure to enable broadcasters, online users, and viewers to interact with each other during live streaming. The company was founded by Xiao Wu He, Pei Lu & Bo Wan in October 2011 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Scienjoy Holding Corp. 在中國提供行動娛樂直播平台。該公司在PC和行動應用程式上經營其平台，用戶可以透過這些平台享受身臨其境的互動娛樂直播。其不同平台包括廣播公司政策、活動、促銷和遊戲。該公司還提供技術基礎設施，使廣播公司、線上用戶和觀眾能夠在直播過程中相互互動。該公司由何曉武、盧培和萬博於2011年10月創立，總部位於中國北京。
